purpose: Apply the V26 workflow to the already frozen V10 mother event: review every 2014-2020 signal chart, distinguish profitable from unprofitable structures, compress observations into at most five causal rules, and freeze those rules before any 2021-plus challenge aggregation.

population.reason: Visual rule discovery must not learn the arbitrary same-date capacity ordering.

frozen_outcome_translation.entry: first legal executable open strictly after the completed signal, no later than three market sessions
frozen_outcome_translation.time_stop: H60 then next legal executable open

visual_questions: Was the pre-signal decline a fast forced-liquidation leg or a long unresolved stair-step decline?
Did the signal occur after mature prior weakness or after a fresh peak with large overhead inventory?
Was the signal a first decisive demand transfer or a late rebound already extended from the local low?
Did the signal beat its industry and board because of stock-specific demand rather than a synchronized rebound?
Was pre-signal turnover contracting before the demand ignition, or was supply still expanding?
Did the signal close through an objective nearby supply level with adequate reward headroom?

challenge_governance.next_step: Freeze at most five chart-derived causal rules, aggregate once on 2014-2020, and only if the requested signal-count and per-signal-return gate survives may the unchanged rule be challenged later.

interpretation: This is post-hoc development research inspired by V26, not independent confirmation.
